description: This file defines a custom autograd Function for per-sample gradients of embedding layers in PyTorch, including forward and backward methods, and utilizes external utility modules.

classes.name: EmbeddingPerSampleGrad
classes.description: A custom autograd Function for computing per-sample gradients of embedding layers in PyTorch.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs the forward pass, applying the embedding function and storing context for backward.

methods.name: backward
methods.description: Computes the gradient of the embedding layer with respect to inputs and weights, supporting per-sample gradient calculation.
